purpose: Literature evidence cards, not calibrated inputs to the synthetic demonstration

cards.title: Do Internships Pay Off? The Effects of Student Internships on Earnings
cards.source_version: author working paper; verify final-paper estimates before numerical use
cards.population: German university graduates in the study cohorts
cards.action: student internship participation induced by mandatory internship requirements
cards.design: instrumental variables using changes in mandatory internship requirements
assumptions: no confounding simultaneous reform invalidating the instrument
transfer_limits: local effect for participation induced by requirements
internship quality, students and labor markets may differ
earnings effects do not directly specify employment-rate or skill effects
cards.reusable: use historical institutional changes and linked graduate outcomes; inspect concurrent reforms
cards.related_work: The earlier Door Opener or Waste of Time? working paper is an earlier version, not independent replication.
cards.data_status: replication data not acquired by this project

cards.title: Student internships and employment opportunities after graduation: A field experiment
cards.population: fictional graduate applications to real job vacancies in the study setting
cards.action: random assignment of internship experience on resumes
assumptions: employer responses represent the studied vacancy context
transfer_limits: resume signaling does not establish acquired skills
interview invitations do not establish final employment or earnings
cards.reusable: separate employer-response mechanisms from student learning and final employment
cards.data_status: replication data not acquired by this project
